C-58.IntentSummary: Ship the approved diagram-gallery prototype as the site's /diagrams/ page: build-time Pele SVGs from a shared examples corpus, theme variables derived from the app's own theme files and buildPeleVariables, theme strip + slideshow + fullscreen show, site integration (brand, head, nav, landing link, sitemap), one honest type count across all materials, and site checks.

Corner.Situation: Visitor in OS dark mode, first visit
Corner.Expected: Ink selected, page chrome dark, marker headline readable

Corner.Situation: Theme switch during Slideshow / Fullscreen show
Corner.Expected: any chip click or Esc stops the timer; no two timers ever run
only the filtered cards are shown; counter reads N of the filtered set
one column, strip scrolls horizontally inside itself, no page h-scroll, show fits the safe area

Corner.Situation: A theme file is added to the app
Corner.Expected: next site build includes it automatically; the vars test count follows the theme directory

Corner.Situation: An example stops parsing after a pele upgrade
Corner.Expected: the gallery unit test and site check fail the build (no silent error card)

T-001.Title: Corpus + theme vars: site/gallery/examples.mjs (port the prototype's 32 examples), gallery-theme-vars.mjs deriving theme-vars.json from the app theme CSS via buildPeleVariables, parity + render tests

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every example renders with pele 1.6.0; 32 themes × 16 keys; Paper/Ink match the 2026-10-18 runtime snapshot.

T-002.Title: Page build: build-gallery.mjs (template, cards, controller script for strip/slideshow/fullscreen/filters/copy), emitted at /diagrams/ in buildEnd and served by the dev middleware

Verification.Command: cd site && npm run build && npm run check

T-003.Title: Integration + count: shared head/consent/analytics, nav "Diagrams", sitemap, landing + README links; reconcile the type count across README/CHANGELOG/What's New/landing

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-4, R-5; landing edits additive and merged after C-57.
